title: Ex 1.4 #12 · {X ∈ 𝒫({1, 2, 3}) : 2 ∈ X}
prompt: Write $\{X \in \mathscr{P}(\{1, 2, 3\}) : 2 \in X\}$ by listing its elements between braces.
answer_format: A set of sets between braces, like {∅, {1}, {1, 2}}. Spaces are optional.
hints: X runs over the subsets of {1, 2, 3}.
Keep the subsets that contain 2: there are four.
solution: The subsets of {1, 2, 3} that contain 2 are {2}, {1, 2}, {2, 3} and {1, 2, 3}.

reference.note: This exact exercise, restated in ProofLab's words.
